title: Quickstart orientation module illustration set
creator: Maya Castillo
description: Refresh the Quickstart landing orientation module with a cohesive illustration system, updated hero variants, step illustrations, and annotated product screenshots suitable for release docs and the Console landing page. Deliver a Figma file with reusable components, exported SVG/PNG assets, responsive layout guidance (desktop/tablet/mobile), and a small dev handoff with markup examples for the Console team. This ticket focuses on the visual assets and documentation; implementation of the markup will be tracked in ENG tickets listed as dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file 'Quickstart Orientation - v1' contains hero illustration with three responsive variants (desktop, tablet, mobile)
Illustration system includes 6 step icons and 3 process diagrams exported as SVG + optimized PNGs
Annotated product screenshots (Desktop Console, Dedicated dashboard, Private deployment modal) captured from runtime-1.19 and exported at 2x for retina
Accessible color palette defined and included as tokens; WCAG AA contrast verified for hero text overlays
Dev handoff doc with example HTML/CSS snippets and CSS variables for spacing/colors added to the Drive folder
All deliverables uploaded to Drive and linked in the ticket; Figma prototype shared with PM and engineering reviewers
screenshots_required: Console - Quickstart CTA visible, logged-in state, timestamped (runtime-1.19)
Dedicated pool creation modal in Dedicated UI (simulate small GPU pool)
Private deployment onboarding modal showing VPC selection
design_notes: Tone: pragmatic, confident — visuals should communicate reliability and low-friction onboarding
Avoid literal server racks; prefer abstract network motifs that map to routing, caching, and efficiency
Use existing Redwood color tokens where possible; introduce one accent color for callouts
Create component variants for light/dark backgrounds; hero text must maintain contrast for both
risks: Final screenshots may change if runtime-1.19 UI updates land late — keep placeholders and a rapid screenshot pass in final week
SVG complexity may require developer optimization; include simplified SVG fallbacks and size budgets
Accessibility tweaks (contrast / alt text) may require additional iteration with Accessibility PM
dev_tasks: Provide 2 example markup snippets (hero with background SVG; step list with inline icons)
Confirm responsive breakpoint behavior with Console frontend owners (ENG-4120)
Add exported asset zips to Drive and tag in the release notes PR
